single_primary_hypothesis.name: Bearish Breakdown Close Position Filter
single_primary_hypothesis.formula_added: h_prev > l_prev and ((c_prev - l_prev) / (h_prev - l_prev)) <= 0.35 on already-closed 4H breakdown bar i-1
single_primary_hypothesis.causality: Strictly causal; uses only OHLC of closed 4H bar i-1 prior to decision timestamp bt = ts4[i].
single_primary_hypothesis.structural_rationale: Frozen RETEST24-R1-R2 v1.5 checks only c_prev < pl and op < pl, admitting weak pokes or bullish-hammer / long-lower-wick absorption bars below the 12-bar swing low. Under conservative 1-bar entry delay (B6 delay1bar_cross_1tick), prior evidence showed edge flipping negative. Requiring the breakdown bar itself to close in the bottom 35% of its range filters out immediate buyer-absorption reversals without loosening entry thresholds or chasing trade count.
unchanged_components: Sort key sk = -rp, limit order trig = False
R1 (12 slots, 150U risk, 600U daily loss) and R2 (12 slots, 100U risk, 400U daily loss)
initial_capital_u = 50000, leverage = 10, maker_fee = 0.0002, taker_fee = 0.0005, slip_mkt = 0.0003, mmr_approx = 0.01

deduplication_against_prior_studies.B6_DELAY_1_BAR: Distinct — delay1bar_cross_1tick is the primary robustness stress test.

evaluation_criteria_for_chatgpt.primary_pass_condition: Under identical EX_USDC_286 window and fair cost/funding, RETEST24_OPT_01_BEARISH_CLOSE_POS improves expectancy and PF over RETEST24_V1_5_FROZEN under BOTH cross_1tick and delay1bar_cross_1tick, and remains net-positive under delay1bar_cross_1tick with acceptable drawdown and non-trivial sample size.
evaluation_criteria_for_chatgpt.fail_stop_condition: If delay1bar_cross_1tick remains net-negative or sample collapses without robust expectancy improvement, mark RETEST24-OPT-01 NO-GO and do not sweep threshold grid without a new structural hypothesis.
